sources.title: Advanced Layout Analysis Models for Docling - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our best model, "heron-101", attains 78% mAP with 28 ms/image inference time on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. Extensive quantitative and qual-itative experiments establish best practices for training, eval-uating, and deploying document-layout detectors, providing actionable guidance for the document conversion commu-nity.
